title: How much of the board does a new agent read before it starts?
context: The board only grows. A new orchestrator or worker needs enough to act correctly without spending its context on history. This sets the reading rule for every agent the hub starts.

options.name: All active entries
options.summary: Every entry that is not superseded or retired, in full.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='40' y='25' width='240' height='130' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>All active entries</text></svg>
cons: Grows without limit; eventually too big to load
Most of it irrelevant to any one task

options.name: Index first, details on demand
options.summary: Every agent reads a short index (one line per active entry), the project brief and the latest handoff; it opens full entries with a tool when it needs them.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='20' y='25' width='120' height='130' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='80' y='80' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Index</text><text x='80' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>brief</text><text x='80' y='108' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>handoff</text><line x1='140' y1='90' x2='178' y2='90' stroke='currentColor' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><polygon points='178,90 171.7,93.0 171.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='180' y='25' width='120' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='240' y='49' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Entry 0007</text><rect x='180' y='70' width='120' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='240' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Entry 0012</text><rect x='180' y='115' width='120' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='240' y='139' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Entry 0019</text></svg>
pros: Same pattern Crux and Claude's own memory use
cons: An agent may skip an entry it should have opened
The one-line summaries must be good

options.name: Role and area digests
options.summary: Entries are tagged by area; the orchestrator reads the whole index, workers read only entries for their area, plus anything marked project-wide.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='110' y='20' width='100' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='44' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Index</text><line x1='130' y1='60' x2='70' y2='105' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='70,105 73.2,98.8 76.9,103.7' fill='currentColor'/><line x1='190' y1='60' x2='250' y2='105' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='250,105 243.1,103.7 246.8,98.8' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='10' y='107' width='120' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='70' y='129' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Orchestrator:</text><text x='70' y='143' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>everything</text><rect x='190' y='107' width='120' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='250' y='129' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Worker:</text><text x='250' y='143' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>its area</text></svg>
cons: Tagging has to be right, or a worker misses a constraint

recommendation: An index plus the brief and handoff keeps start-up small however big the board gets; area tags (C) can be layered on once projects get large.

settles.value: one-line index, project brief and latest handoff; full entries on demand
